# Hack Life Journal

## October 5th

Today I figured out how to set up an **SSD1306 OLED display**, using a website called **Wokwi**. Wokwi provides virtual components that simulate how they would work in real life, before using actual hardware. You can even code Arduino code on it that functions with the electronic tools.

###  OLED Display Setup
![Screenshot 2026-10-05 at 5.38.45 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gkojKygsM9FRIeDe3FDErW56Isuc9VSK/e667e6eea4e40925b562b0b3509f210affd0f0d8b1e4ed630d6562774e99d327.png)

###  What I Learned
- How to connect and configure an **SSD1306 OLED display**.
- How to use **Wokwi** to simulate electronic circuits
- Display custom text on the OLED screen.
- Create scrolling text effect

### Struggles & Lessons Learned
-  **Arduino Mega**, the **SDA** pin always connects to **Digital Pin 20**.
- **SCL** pin always connects to **Digital Pin 21**.
- Couldn't find an **Arduino Mega 2560** in KiCad

I was so confused because when I researched the Oled Display for Arduinos, it said that SDA goes to A5 and that SCL to A4. I did so more research and found out that SCL and SDA goes to different pins depending on the microcontroller. Since KiCad doesn't have the mega 2560, I made a practice schematic of my design of the display, which I put in my Lapse.
### Plans For Tomorrow
-  Build Practice PCBS by watching youtube
